topic: Football satire/meme: Vinícius Júnior may never get his Real Madrid wing spot back because Yan Diomande is thriving
hero: Vinícius Júnior (captioned) and Yan Diomande (captioned, in Real Madrid training top)
hero_role: Vinícius is the butt of the joke; Diomande the usurper; meme clips act as reactions
hook: Interview-style clip of man on sofa with caption 'Vinicius junior', first words of narration appear as subtitles
subtitle_style: small white bold sans-serif subtitle, bottom-centre, one or two words at a time on dark pill/black outline; words appear word by word in sync with narration
reaction_overlays: meme reaction clips (people laughing, eating, streamer reacting), FUT/PSG kit streamer overlay, split with Barça-kit players clap, gym meme
transition_summary: Rapid hard cuts between unrelated meme clips matched to narration beats (about 4-5 cuts/10s, 24 in 59s); subtitles sync every word
audio_note: English TTS-style narration ('I swear man, Vinícius Júnior might genuinely never get his starting spot back at Real Madrid because ever since...') over meme audio

reuse_segments.what: Meme reaction clips and sourced interview clips
reuse_segments.how_to_reuse: Third-party meme clips; recreate with own narration and generic/AI reaction visuals; reuse word-by-word subtitle format
